truthNote: Research and working analysis only — not tax, customs, legal, or investment advice. Tariff entries are NOT broker-verified.

sources.title: China-origin apparel into US as of 2026-08-22: MFN (~16.5% typical knit) + Section 301 List 4A 7.5% + Section 301 2026 determination 12.5% (effective 2026-07-24) ≈ ~36.5% typical (with portless.com and tariffstool.com corroboration)
sources.limitations: Broker/vendor syntheses of USTR actions; NOT broker-verified for VORG HTS codes; regime changed 3x in 6 months; second China investigation open.

sources.title: Vietnam-origin apparel into US as of 2026-08-22: MFN + Section 301 2026 12.5% tier (dockets USTR-2026-0265/0266, effective 2026-07-24) ≈ ~29% typical; no List 4A layer (with tariffstool.com and vneconomy.vn corroboration)
sources.limitations: Secondary syntheses; NOT broker-verified; possible apparel TRQ/lower-tier developments unconfirmed.

sources.title: SCOTUS struck down IEEPA reciprocal/fentanyl tariffs 2026-02-20 (Learning Resources v. Trump); Section 122 10% bridge expired 2026-07-24; CIT upheld de minimis elimination 2026-08-13
sources.limitations: Law-firm summary of litigation; primary opinions not read in full.

sources.title: Federal Register 2026-06-24: de minimis exemption indefinitely suspended for all modes (19 CFR 10.151 / 145.31); OBBBA statutory termination 2027-07-01

sources.title: CUSMA Uniform Regulations (RoO ch.4/6) — apparel yarn-forward rules; 10% de minimis fiber weight; storage/relabeling in Canada confers no origin (with afslaw.com and Canada Gazette SOR/2020-155 corroboration)
sources.limitations: Not legal advice; product-specific rules per HTS heading must be checked individually.

sources.title: Transshipment/false-origin enforcement continues after 40% IEEPA transshipment duty ended Feb 2026; misdeclaration remains 19 USC 1592 exposure
sources.limitations: Paywalled analysis (abstract only); legal-risk framing is VORG working synthesis — counsel to confirm.

sources.title: Canada apparel import: ~18% MFN on HS 61/62 (China-origin) + 5% GST on duty-paid value
sources.limitations: Aggregator; verify per code in CBSA Customs Tariff 2026.

sources.title: CBSA 2026 tariff treatments: Vietnam has CPTPT treatment (potential 0% apparel if CPTPP ch.4 rules of origin met); China MFN only (with epicsourcing.ca, tradecommissioner.gc.ca, and SOR/2018-223 corroboration)
sources.limitations: Qualification is not automatic: yarn/fabric origin declarations, certificate of origin, and direct-shipment proof required; Chinese-fabric garments likely fail.

workingAssumptions: Consumer health composite indices (US ~42 worsening, CA ~50 flat) are founder-judgment blends of the sourced indicators, not measured indices.
Scenario weights base 0.55 / upside 0.20 / downside 0.25 are working planning weights, not measured probabilities.

Typical duty stacks (CN→US ~36.5%, VN→US ~29%, CN→CA ~18%+GST, VN→CA 0% if CPTPP-qualified) use example MFN rates, not VORG's real HTS codes — customs broker verification required before any PO or price promise.
All landed-cost illustrations use unquoted internal COGS planning numbers from sku-inventory.json.
